website quality is an antecedent of social presence and telepresence, which are, in turn, antecedents of website identification, and that website identification is a mediator between presence and purchase intention.

information and service website quality positively affect social presence and telepresence, which in turn positively affect website identification and purchase intentions, and that information and service but not system quality affect website identification.
website quality influences presence and that presence in turn influences website identification and purchase intentions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues.
how website quality influences buyers’ perceived presence and how perceived presence in turn affects website identity and purchase intention.
the role of website qualities in the presence of an online shopping website and the effect of the presence on website identification and purchase behavior.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
sellers' website quality is a significant factor that affects consumers' perceived website presence, which further affects consumers' website identification and purchase behavior.
sellers' information and service quality have a significant influence on buyers' perceived presence and website identification.
the quality of sellers' websites influences buyers' perceived website presence, which in turns affects website identification and ultimately influences purchase intention.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the quality of a website is a key factor in building a presence in an online store.
sellers should focus on the website quality of information, service, and system to enhance the social presence and telepresence of their website and increase the website identification of buyers.
website quality has a positive influence on presence and presence in turn affects identification and purchase intention.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sellers should improve the quality of their website to enhance the perceived presence of buyers.

the quality of a seller's website is an important factor for building a positive relationship with buyers, and that the presence created by website quality is a key driver in the development of website identification and purchase intentions.
sellers should pay attention to their websites' quality to increase their presence and improve their customers' online shopping experience.
